_note: The office is a floor plan. Each department is a room; each room holds stations; each station is occupied by an agent that can be replaced. The app draws this file. The Manager edits it when a department opens.

departments.name: Harvest
departments.purpose: Everything the student reads or prints: public papers, models, banks, notes, print files, QA.

departments.name: Marketing
departments.purpose: Getting the app in front of parents: reels, WhatsApp campaigns, school visits, local ads, referral loop.
departments.unlock_condition: The Harvest room is producing gated files and the app is live for parents.

departments.name: Video & Live
departments.purpose: Centum's live classes and recordings — the shelf the owner can charge for.
departments.unlock_condition: One test opens and one recording opens (the Centum gate in OFFICE.md §6).

departments.name: Website (Qwen lane)
departments.purpose: StudyHub UI, chips, catalogue.json, checkout. Not staffed by this office.

power._note: The app compares the newest of (agent logs, manager run, heartbeat file, build time) against these to decide whether the office lights are on.
